news.title: Carrick to stay in charge of Man Utd for Chelsea game
news.description: Michael Carrick will remain in charge of Manchester United for their trip to Chelsea this weekend.

news.title: How 'anti-superstar' Kane defied doubters to become world's best
news.description: Harry Kane is the humble 'anti-superstar' who defied doubters to achieve Ballon d'Or greatness, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.

news.title: Ranking England's Ballon d'Or winners - how does Kane compare?
news.description: From Stanley Matthews to Harry Kane, how do England's Ballon d'Or winners rank?

news.title: Putellas wins record-equalling third Ballon d'Or to extend Spanish dominance
news.description: Barcelona and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d'Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

news.title: How Kane's Ballon d'Or win could boost the Bundesliga
news.description: Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or win not only ended a 25-year wait for an English winner of the award but also saw a Bundesliga player win it for the first time since 1996.

news.title: Milne out for season as Hearts' injury woes continue
news.description: Heart of Midlothian defender Harry Milne's season is over after he sustains an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury, head coach Wouter Vrancken confirms.

news.title: No Saliba, no problem - Konsa stepping up for Arsenal
news.description: Arsenal's defensive form is testament to the performances of Ezri Konsa, who has stepped up in William Saliba's absence and been given his chance to shine.

news.title: Ballon d'Or in London - the most chaotic ever?
news.description: It was the first time the Ballon d'Or had been held in London in its 70-year history - but the event was not plain sailing. BBC Sport assesses a chaotic night.

news.title: Quiz: Kane and who else? Name every men's Ballon d'Or winner
news.description: Do you know every winner since the very first recipient of the Ballon d'Or, way back in 1956?

news.title: Why is Wilcox in line of fire from Man Utd fans?
news.description: With Michael Carrick's position as Man Utd boss under scrutiny, focus has also turned to director of football Jason Wilcox.
